projects.projectName: Premera Blue Cross - Producer Portal Development - Phase 1

riskDescription.context: The project has absorbed approximately 14 scope changes equivalent to 0.75–1 sprint of additional effort, and R857 remains Identified with mitigation plan not yet arrived (EMS).
riskDescription.condition: Further scope additions may exceed remaining budget and schedule buffer.
riskDescription.consequence: Delivery timelines could slip or margin could erode if additional effort is not absorbed or negotiated with the client.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Establish formal scope change control with impact assessment and customer approval before acceptance to prevent uncontrolled effort expansion.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon exceeding one sprint buffer, rebaseline delivery plan with customer, prioritize critical-path features, and escalate to project board within 48 hours.

riskDescription.context: Azure 4xx/5xx alerts are currently disabled and retry logic requires update to classify invalid email-format failures as non-retryable before re-enabling (EMS go-green plan).
riskDescription.condition: Production issues may go undetected or false-positive P4 incidents may recur if the retry logic change is not deployed and validated successfully.
riskDescription.consequence: Operational stability could weaken and client trust in monitoring and incident response may decline.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Deploy and validate retry logic update in Production, re-enable Azure 4xx/5xx alerts, and conduct Hypercare monitoring to prevent false-positive incidents.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should false-positive P4 incidents recur post-deployment, roll back retry logic change and notify engineering lead and client within 24 hours.

riskDescription.context: Citrix slowness and frequent disconnections are impacting delivery, and a ticket to address the issue with Premera has not yet been raised (EMS go-green plan).
riskDescription.condition: Team productivity may continue to degrade if Citrix infrastructure issues are not resolved promptly.
riskDescription.consequence: Sprint velocity could decline and delivery timelines may be impacted.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Raise ticket with Premera infrastructure team, track downtime in Confluence, and request VDI support coverage during offshore hours to prevent productivity loss.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If Citrix issues persist beyond two weeks, reprioritize tasks to non-dependent workstreams and notify delivery manager and client.

riskDescription.context: R856 and R855 related to Data Hub API integration and delivery are marked Resolved in EMS, but no evidence of completed performance or NFR validation is available.
riskDescription.condition: Performance bottlenecks or NFR failures may surface during later testing or go-live if validation was incomplete.
riskDescription.consequence: Late-stage rework could delay go-live and weaken client confidence in release readiness.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Conduct performance and NFR validation testing on live Data Hub APIs before UAT exit, prioritizing critical flows to prevent late-stage bottlenecks.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon detecting performance bottlenecks during UAT, rebaseline impacted scope with customer, defer non-critical features, and notify project board.
